question: According to what model are the applications of this practice to be performed?
premises: All applications and related procedures are included.
These belong to this goddess or mantra.
They are proclaimed to follow the Tripurā model.
inference: All applications of this practice are to be performed in the same manner as those of Tripurā.
plain_english: All her applications and related procedures are proclaimed to be just like those of Tripurā.
